verdict.rationale: Lowenstein Sandler is a law firm offering legal services such as venture deals, IP, employment and privacy counsel, so issuing scoped API credentials for agents is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships an API or credential system: the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all paths, and the Clerky partnership covers formation workflows, not API access.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
